sources.title: Qwen3.5 0.8B: Run & Benchmark the Smallest Multimodal LLM
sources.snippet: Quick answer. Qwen3.5 0.8B is Alibaba's smallest multimodal model, with a 262K context window and native vision support. Pull it with `ollama run qwen3.5:0.8b` for text or run the GGUF in llama.cpp for image input. Expect strong recall but weak code accuracy — bump to Qwen3.5 4B for any coding task.

sources.title: NL2Shell — Natural Language to Shell Commands - GitHub
sources.snippet: Convert plain English into executable shell commands using an 800M-parameter model that runs on your laptop. NL2Shell is an open-source fine-tune of Qwen3.5-0.8B — a hybrid DeltaNet architecture with 75% linear + 25% softmax attention layers — trained on 11,894 deduplicated natural language to bash pairs using QLoRA. It outputs only the shell command, no explanations, no markdown fences ...

sources.snippet: Part of First Break AI — a free, open cohort to learn AI by doing. Run Qwen 3 0.6B on your Mac with minimal setup: pure C inference, no Python, no CUDA, no cloud. This repo bundles the inference code, a sampling visualizer, and a step-by-step guide so you can run the model and understand how it works.
